Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 is a compact, high-performance wireless development board powered by the Espressif ESP32-S3R8 SoC. It also includes USB Type-C connectivity, lithium-battery charging management, Reset and Boot buttons, and user-programmable status indicators. Its castellated pads and single-sided component layout make it suitable for both rapid prototyping and surface-mount integration into custom PCBs.
